lines.text: The Common. Hours later. The Tilt has almost faded.
Seismographs on the Reaches went quiet an hour ago. The Ochre Span is holding.
The Dominion filed a complaint. Forty pages. I'm framing page twelve.
The Dominion contract paid out. Supply lines are full for a month. The Span's sensors are... noisy.
Bridges don't fail all at once. They fail when everyone stops listening.
He's going to go back out there. I've seen it from four directions.
Ecology flagged a disturbed grazer herd near the waystation. It will recover. Slowly.
And the plate beetles walked away from the drill site on their own. That's the outcome I'll be quoting.
Now. You brought life home with you. That makes it ours to keep alive.
We also pulled a dust grazer off the drill perimeter — Protective Extraction. It's stressed. It needs a Habitat.
Habitats aren't cages. They're medicine. Soil, microbes, light, symbionts, a tuned Scale Anchor.
Get the chain right and it lives. Get it wrong and it won't. Habitat Wing's open.
